description: Defines Mojo StructTraits specializations for serializing and deserializing media::ResolutionBitrateLimit and media::VideoEncoderInfo structures used in video encoder info traits.

methods.name: frame_size
methods.description: Returns the frame size from ResolutionBitrateLimit.

methods.name: min_start_bitrate_bps
methods.description: Returns the minimum start bitrate in bps.

methods.name: min_bitrate_bps
methods.description: Returns the minimum bitrate in bps.

methods.name: max_bitrate_bps
methods.description: Returns the maximum bitrate in bps.

methods.name: implementation_name
methods.description: Returns the implementation name of the VideoEncoderInfo.

methods.name: has_frame_delay
methods.description: Checks if frame delay has a value.

methods.name: frame_delay
methods.description: Returns the frame delay or 0 if not set.

methods.name: has_input_capacity
methods.description: Checks if input capacity has a value.

methods.name: input_capacity
methods.description: Returns the input capacity or 0 if not set.

methods.name: supports_native_handle
methods.description: Indicates if native handle is supported.

methods.name: has_trusted_rate_controller
methods.description: Indicates if a trusted rate controller is present.

methods.name: is_hardware_accelerated
methods.description: Indicates if hardware acceleration is used.

methods.name: supports_simulcast
methods.description: Indicates if simulcast is supported.

methods.name: reports_average_qp
methods.description: Indicates if average QP reporting is supported.

methods.name: apply_alignment_to_all_simulcast_layers
methods.description: Indicates if alignment applies to all simulcast layers.

methods.name: requested_resolution_alignment
methods.description: Returns the requested resolution alignment.

methods.name: fps_allocation
methods.description: Returns the FPS allocation span.

methods.name: resolution_bitrate_limits
methods.description: Returns the resolution bitrate limits.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Deserialization method for ResolutionBitrateLimit.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Deserialization method for VideoEncoderInfo.
